section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Yehudah's approach to Yosef represents the arousal of feminine waters from the side of Ban, which is accomplished through a drawing from the name Mah, linking this to the concept of attaching redemption to prayer and the distinction between clarifications from below upward and from above downward.
section.t: And it is known,
that in order to arouse the elevation of the feminine waters of Ban,
this itself is through a drawing from the name Mah.
And this is what is said in the Zohar, that Yehudah's approach to Yosef is the matter of attaching redemption to prayer,
for Yehudah's approach to Yosef is the elevation of the feminine waters of the tribes
[Yehudah is the primary of the tribes]
to Yosef,
to arouse the drawing of masculine waters from the name Mah, so that there will be the second clarification from above downward.
[And this is what our sages said
on the verse "And Yehudah approached him" — "And he approached" means only for peace,
because the quality of the clarification that is in the manner of from above downward
(the clarification of Yosef)
is that it is in a manner of peace.
And it is known
the difference between the clarification of prayer and the clarification of Torah,
that the clarification of prayer, which is from below upward, is in a manner of war,
and the clarification of Torah, which is from above downward, is in a manner of rest and peace.
And within Torah itself,
the difference between the clarification through the revealed aspect of Torah and the clarification through the inner aspect of Torah].
And the giving of power for the elevation of the feminine waters of Malchus to Zeir Anpin,
the approach of Yehudah to Yosef,
is through the drawing from Zeir Anpin to Malchus,
the attaching of redemption to prayer.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the phrase "attaching redemption to prayer" indicates that prayer is primary, because the ultimate intent of a dwelling place in the lower realms is achieved specifically through the clarification from below upward, where the lower being becomes a vessel for Divinity.
section.t: And the expression "attaching redemption to prayer" indicates
(as above)
that prayer is the primary thing,
for
the primary intent of a dwelling place in the lower realms is in the clarification that is in the manner of from below upward,
the clarification of Ban.
For the clarification in the manner of from above downward,
the clarification of Mah,
since the clarification is from the aspect of the revelation of light
(and not from the aspect of the lower being itself),
it is not so connected to the lower being itself,
and the intent of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed specifically through the clarification in the manner of from below upward,
that the lower being becomes a vessel for Divinity.
And therefore in the future, Yehudah will be above Yosef,
as it is stated in the haftarah of the portion of Vayigash
"And My servant Dovid shall be king over them... and Dovid My servant shall be their prince forever."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section raises a question: if the clarification of Ban will be above Mah only in the future, and currently Mah is above Ban, how does Yehudah's approach to Yosef show the superiority of Malchus over Zeir Anpin?
section.t: And one must understand,
behold, that the clarification of Ban is above Mah will be in the future,
and now Mah is above Ban,
and the matter of attaching redemption to prayer is that now prayer is above redemption.
And also one must understand,
that from what the Zohar said that Yehudah's approach to Yosef is the matter of attaching redemption to prayer,
it implies,
that also in Yehudah's approach to Yosef, the superiority of Malchus over Zeir Anpin is evident.
